name: storage_account
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Azure Storage Account, provisioned within an environment and resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this storage account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Storage account name. 3-24 characters, lowercase letters and numbers, globally unique across Azure. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the storage account is provisioned.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the storage account is provisioned.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs linking this storage account to a cloud provider account. Inherited from the resource group; not user-settable.

attributes.name: sku_name
attributes.description: Redundancy/performance SKU (e.g. Standard_LRS, Standard_GRS, Premium_LRS). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Storage account kind. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: is_hns_enabled
attributes.description: Enable hierarchical namespace (Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: is_nfs_v3_enabled
attributes.description: Enable NFS v3 protocol support (requires is_hns_enabled). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: is_sftp_enabled
attributes.description: Enable SFTP support (requires is_hns_enabled).

attributes.name: allow_cross_tenant_replication
attributes.description: Allow object replication across Azure AD tenants.

attributes.name: access_tier
attributes.description: Default blob access tier.

attributes.name: minimum_tls_version
attributes.description: Minimum TLS version accepted for requests.

attributes.name: allow_blob_public_access
attributes.description: Allow anonymous public read access to blobs/containers.

attributes.name: enable_https_traffic_only
attributes.description: Require HTTPS for all traffic to the storage account.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the storage account. The platform adds its own managed `duplocloud-ai-*` tags server-side; those are filtered out of state so only your tags are managed by Terraform.

attributes.name: data_protection
attributes.description: Blob/container/file-share data protection settings (soft delete, versioning, point-in-time restore). Applied on update.

attributes.name: enable_blob_soft_delete
attributes.description: Enable soft delete for blobs.

attributes.name: blob_soft_delete_retention_days
attributes.description: Retention period (days) for soft-deleted blobs.

attributes.name: enable_container_soft_delete
attributes.description: Enable soft delete for containers.

attributes.name: container_soft_delete_retention_days
attributes.description: Retention period (days) for soft-deleted containers.

attributes.name: enable_file_share_soft_delete
attributes.description: Enable soft delete for file shares.

attributes.name: file_share_soft_delete_retention_days
attributes.description: Retention period (days) for soft-deleted file shares.

attributes.name: enable_versioning
attributes.description: Enable blob versioning.

attributes.name: enable_point_in_time_restore
attributes.description: Enable point-in-time restore for block blobs (auto-enables versioning and blob soft delete).

attributes.name: point_in_time_restore_retention_days
attributes.description: Point-in-time restore window (days). Must be less than the blob soft-delete retention.

attributes.name: azure_resource_group_name
attributes.description: Azure resource group the storage account is created in. Derived from the linked resource group; not user-settable.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type. Defaults to DirectApiCall for Azure passthrough resources.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the storage account.

attributes.name: storage_account_id
attributes.description: ID of this storage account, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: azure_resource_id
attributes.description: Full Azure resource ID (ARM ID) of the provisioned storage account.

attributes.name: provisioning_state
attributes.description: Azure provisioning state of the storage account (e.g. Succeeded).

attributes.name: primary_blob_endpoint
attributes.description: Primary Blob service endpoint URL.

attributes.name: primary_file_endpoint
attributes.description: Primary File service endpoint URL.

attributes.name: primary_queue_endpoint
attributes.description: Primary Queue service endpoint URL.

attributes.name: primary_table_endpoint
attributes.description: Primary Table service endpoint URL.

attributes.name: private_endpoint_infos
attributes.description: Private endpoints connected to the storage account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Private endpoint name.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Private endpoint resource ID.

attributes.name: provisioning_state
attributes.description: Provisioning state of the private endpoint.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Connection status of the private endpoint.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storage account was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storage account was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
